title: Generative Representation Learning for Scalable Latent Tokenization
abstract: arXiv:2610.20533v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce an approach for self-supervised representation learning designed to be used as a tokenizer for generative modeling. Our objective supervises a representation loss by factorizing the pointwise mutual information of the data, which we estimate by taking information differences between conditional predictions from a learned generative model. We justify our algorithm theoretically and empirically, demonstrating that our generative approach to representation learning avoids dimensional collapse and feature suppression in cases where commonly used methods like DINO and LeJEPA fail. Moreover, we show our representation learning technique is scalable; expending more compute leads to predictably better latent tokenization. For the first time, we perform a careful analysis of the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model and demonstrate that our approach is a compute-optimal improvement over direct diffusion for pixel

translated_title: 用于可扩展潜在分词的生成式表示学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种自监督表示学习方法，专门设计用作生成建模的分词器（tokenizer）。我们的目标通过分解数据的逐点互信息来监督表示损失，该互信息通过计算一个学习到的生成模型的条件预测之间的信息差来估计。我们从理论和实证两方面论证了我们的算法，证明我们的生成式表示学习方法能够避免维度坍缩和特征抑制问题，而在这些情况下，DINO和LeJEPA等常用方法则会失效。此外，我们展示了我们的表示学习技术具有可扩展性；投入更多计算资源可以带来可预期的更好的潜在分词效果。我们首次对分词器和生成模型的综合浮点运算效率进行了细致分析，并证明我们的方法在像素任务上是相对于直接扩散的一种计算最优的改进。
tldr: 提出了一种基于逐点互信息分解的生成式自监督表示学习方法，能够避免维度坍缩和特征抑制、随算力增加可预期地提升分词质量，并在分词器与生成模型的综合计算效率上首次实现了优于直接扩散的计算最优改进。
en_tdlr: Proposes a generative self-supervised representation learning method based on factorizing pointwise mutual information that avoids dimensional collapse, scales predictably with compute, and for the first time achieves compute-optimal improvements over direct diffusion in the combined flop efficiency of tokenizer and generative model.
